purpose: Record that the shipped copper (produced by the recipe's full fill engine: native fill + starved-thermal remediation + the #3711 foreign-pad clearance carve) is NOT equivalent to the copper a bare native `kicad-cli pcb drc --refill-zones` produces. Two zero-finding reports from the two engines therefore do not describe the same candidate -- the saved-vs-refilled invariant documented at the top of src/kicad_tools/cli/readiness_cmd.py. Physical compatibility remains unresolved in #5380. The #5391 producer correction alone cannot clear this physical gate.
measured_by: PR #5386 Doctor, independent re-measurement on loom-worker-2; corroborates two prior independent reviewer measurements (pinned 10.0.5 and 10.0.6).

engine.recipe_fill: boards/03-usb-joystick recipe run_fill_zones: native fill, then starved-thermal remediation and the #3711 foreign-pad clearance carve. Retained result: output/readiness/fill-consistency.json (0 mm^2 delta, recipe-vs-recipe).

commands: kicad-cli pcb drc --format json --output saved-drc.json saved/usb_joystick_routed.kicad_pcb
kicad-cli pcb drc --refill-zones --save-board --format json --output refilled-drc.json refilled/usb_joystick_routed.kicad_pcb
inputs: Two separate copies of the committed release, each with the full project context the board needs: usb_joystick_routed.kicad_pcb/.kicad_pro/.kicad_dru, fp-lib-table and the custom output/footprints library. Both copies start from the canonical saved PCB.
area_method: Per-zone/per-layer shoelace sum over every `filled_polygon` point list parsed directly out of the .kicad_pcb s-expression (KiCad writes fractured polygon sets, so hole slits contribute zero area). Independent of pcbnew and of the recipe's own area code.

refilled.note: This refilled board is a measurement artifact only. It is deliberately NOT shipped and the release is NOT rebound to it: doing so would discard the recipe's clearance carve.

conclusion: Bare native refill adds copper on all four poured layers and collapses the carved pours (F.Cu 50 -> 1 filled polygons), so the shipped geometry and the natively refilled geometry are physically different candidates. Zero native error/open counts on either candidate do not establish equivalence between them. The shipped copper is what was checked by `kct check`, copper LVS and the saved-byte native DRC below; the required same-copper native-refill gate is unresolved.

pinned_10_0_5_prior_reviewer.note: pcbnew GetFilledPolysList().Area(); reproduced here to <1e-6 mm^2 by an independent parser.

kicad_10_0_6_prior_reviewer.note: Same four deltas; the refilled bytes differ between KiCad 10.0.5 and 10.0.6, the saved bytes do not.

not_established_here: That the recipe carve is wrong, or that the shipped copper violates any factory rule.
Physical/supplier qualification, USB enumeration or hardware bring-up.
A fix for the generic `kct readiness` zone_fill gate -- that is issue #5391.
